cobbleeffort.species.amalgum.desc: Three Cavitot that had their cavities filled and fused into one. The metal in their fillings makes it tough to crack, but all three of its faces still frown. It gnaws on iron ore to keep its caps shiny.
cobbleeffort.species.amalgum.name: Amalgum
cobbleeffort.species.cavitot.desc: It started out as a baby tooth that was never brushed. The cavity in its crown aches all the time, which is why it always looks so grumpy. It can't resist sweets, even though they make the ache worse.
cobbleeffort.species.cavitot.name: Cavitot
cobbleeffort.species.cinderoon.desc: Once it has eaten enough coal, it wraps its soft body in a cocoon of cinders. The ash is thin enough to see the Coalarva curled up inside, and it can burn some of it away to hurl a blast of fire at anything that disturbs it.
cobbleeffort.species.cinderoon.name: Cinderoon
cobbleeffort.species.coalarva.desc: It lives in caves deep underground where coal seams run thick, and it eats nothing but coal. A special organ in its abdomen turns the minerals it swallows into heat, which is why its tail end always glows.
cobbleeffort.species.coalarva.name: Coalarva
cobbleeffort.species.gatterfly.desc: Its arms have become guns that spray stingers so fast and so hot they glow, and its wings are made of fire. Besides fighting with them, it melts stone with its flames to build its nest.
cobbleeffort.species.gatterfly.name: Gatterfly
cobbleeffort.species.mantasma.desc: A Mawntis that hunted on a moonless night and came back as something else. It towers over the trees, its grin glows in the dark, and its ghostly scythes cut through anything without ever missing. Even so, it still clasps its forelegs together the way it did as a Prayling.
cobbleeffort.species.mantasma.name: Mantasma
cobbleeffort.species.mawntis.desc: Its head has split into a maw full of fangs, and a second set of legs lets it run down prey in the undergrowth. It still has no eyes, but its scythes find their mark every time.
cobbleeffort.species.mawntis.name: Mawntis
cobbleeffort.species.orthodread.desc: Eight teeth held together by braces it can never take off. It scuttles through dark caves on its steel legs and its bite can crunch through iron. The braces put it in a foul mood, and it takes that out on anyone it meets.
cobbleeffort.species.orthodread.name: Orthodread
cobbleeffort.species.prayling.desc: It is born without eyes, yet it never misses. It feels the faintest stir of air through its leafy feelers and knows exactly where its prey is, then holds its little forelegs together and waits.
cobbleeffort.species.prayling.name: Prayling
cobblemon.ability.blindsight.desc: The Pokémon is blind, yet it senses everything around it: every move it uses hits, whatever its accuracy, and even targets that are flying, underground or underwater.
cobblemon.move.machinegunstinger.desc: Spins up its Gatling arms and sprays the target with red-hot stingers two to five times in a row. Each stinger may leave the target with a burn.
cobblemon.species.brutebonnet-mega.desc: Its stalk has grown into a colossal trunk like the giant fungi of ancient times, taller than the trees around it. Moss hangs from its cap, and its fists can fell a forest.
cobblemon.species.fluttermane-mega.desc: Its feathery mane spreads like great wings and its beads glow with eerie light. Its cries are said to drive whole villages from their homes.
cobblemon.species.gougingfire-mega.desc: Its golden mane flares into a crown of flame. The ground smoulders under its hooves.
cobblemon.species.greattusk-mega.desc: Its tusks have grown into great curling arcs and its hide into stone-hard plates. It rolls through mountains as if they were sand.
cobblemon.species.ironboulder-mega.desc: Its horn-blade glows white-hot and its armour has grown into a moving fortress.
cobblemon.species.ironbundle-mega.desc: Its sack has become a huge cannon of ice. It glides through blizzards it makes itself.
cobblemon.species.ironcrown-mega.desc: Its crest-blades have spread into a crown of floating swords that guard it on every side.
cobblemon.species.ironhands-mega.desc: Its hands have grown into colossal pistons. One punch can flatten a building.
cobblemon.species.ironjugulis-mega.desc: Its three heads glow with targeting lights and its wings have turned to blades.
cobblemon.species.ironleaves-mega.desc: Its blade-horns have grown into a crest of glowing swords that can cut through steel.
cobblemon.species.ironmoth-mega.desc: Its wing panels have spread into a blazing halo that scorches the air around it.
cobblemon.species.ironthorns-mega.desc: Its armour has thickened into a fortress of spikes humming with electricity.
cobblemon.species.irontreads-mega.desc: Its treads have widened into great glowing wheels. It speeds across the land like a runaway train.
cobblemon.species.ironvaliant-mega.desc: Its blades have lengthened into a flowing cape of light. It fights as gracefully as it dances.
cobblemon.species.koraidon-mega.desc: Its wing-feathers have unfurled into a blazing crown. The sun is said to burn hotter wherever it spreads them.
cobblemon.species.miraidon-mega.desc: Its body-fins have flared into wings of pure light. It races through the sky faster than lightning.
cobblemon.species.ragingbolt-mega.desc: Its storm-cloud mane crackles constantly. Lightning is said to answer its roar.
cobblemon.species.roaringmoon-mega.desc: Its wings have joined into a great crescent like a blood-red moon. Old tales say it rose on nights when the moon turned red.
cobblemon.species.sandyshocks-mega.desc: Its magnets have grown into great arches crackling with sand. It drags whole sandstorms behind it.
cobblemon.species.screamtail-mega.desc: Its fluffy mane bristles and its tail has grown long enough to coil round its foes. Its scream can shatter boulders.
cobblemon.species.slitherwing-mega.desc: Its six wings blaze like a wildfire. It crawls through the forest on its many legs, scorching all it touches.
cobblemon.species.walkingwake-mega.desc: Its mane streams like burning water. Old stories say rain followed wherever it walked.
